title: pcell + label-free phoretic slip: particle-filled cells keep a link ring (rim/core 1.6) only below the swimming transition; above it they swim 40-90 body lengths but lose ring and division
summary: c05's label-free slip v = mu G12[phi^2 grad S]/G12[phi^2] phi^2 (MUSCL advection of phi and L; particles ride the same flow before their gated Brownian step) was added to pcell. At mu=2.2 seed 0 forms 42 walled cells whose L ring passes the labkit test (rim/core 1.62, 202/225 individuals membrane-like) with 13 persistent splits (gen 2), but they hardly swim (max 3.4 body lengths in 24000 t), while seed 1 fuses into one domain-spanning body. At mu=2.5-4.0 (seed 0, 8000 t) cells swim 41-87 body lengths, but the ring drops to 1.18-1.39 and persistent splits to 1-4 (gen 1), the same ring-motility trade-off c05 found in the field version. No motile-dividing-ringed regime found yet; screen.txt has the numbers.
